text: N250047February 20, 2014CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:361 CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6106.20.2010  Ms. Karen PaitsellAugusta Sportswear425 Park West Drive Grovetown, GA 30813RE:  The tariff classification of a woman’s shirt from ChinaDear Ms. Paitsell:In your letter dated January 31, 2014, you requested a tariff classification ruling on behalf of your client, Holloway. Your sample will be returned as requested.Style 222315 is a woman’s shirt constructed from 92% polyester and 8% spandex knit fabric. The garment features a stand-up collar, a partial front opening with a zipper closure, contrasting color knit fabric inserts at the front upper neckline and extending down the long sleeves, rib knit cuffs with thumb holes, contrasting color knit fabric inserts extending across the rear upper back from side seam to side seam, and a small heat seal logo on the right lower sleeve. The hemmed garment extends to below the waist and is slightly longer at the back. The garment has at least 10 or more stitches per linear centimeter measured in both directions.The applicable subheading for style 222315 will be 6106.20.2010, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for Women’s or girls’ blouses and shirts, knitted or crocheted: Of man-made fibers: Other: Women’s. The duty rate will be 32% ad valorem. Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change. The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on the World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported. If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Kimberly Rackett at (646) 733-3051.Sincerely,Gwenn Klein KirschnerActing DirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
